## Home

# Trackly — Build calm routines. Observe steady progress.

Trackly is a distraction-free workspace designed to record daily habits, observe momentum, and stay consistent without gamified noise. It is free, privacy-first, and installable as a Progressive Web App.

### What you can do

- Record daily habits and activities in seconds.
- Create custom categories with names, units, colors, and icons.
- Track numeric values such as minutes, pages, cups, kilometers, or simple checkmarks.
- Build consecutive-day streaks.
- View a 90-day contribution heatmap of your consistency.
- Share progress summaries as image cards.
- Use the same account across phone and desktop.
- Delete individual entries or your entire account at any time.

### How it works

1. Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email, or continue with Google.
2. Add the routines you want to track, each with its own unit and color.
3. Log an entry whenever you complete an activity.
4. Review streaks, heatmaps, and progress summaries in the dashboard.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Is Trackly free to use?

Yes. Trackly is completely free for personal activity and habit tracking — no premium tiers, no ads.

#### How do I install Trackly on my mobile phone?

Click the "Get App" or "Download App" button in the navigation header. On iOS or Android, select "Add to Home Screen" to install Trackly as a Progressive Web App (PWA).

#### Can I track habits with custom units like minutes or liters?

Yes. Every category can be customized with specific target units (e.g. Minutes, Pages, Cups, Km) or left as a simple checkmark.

#### Can I sign in with Google?

Yes. Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email, or continue instantly with your Google account. New accounts are created after the email code is verified.

#### Can I use Trackly on multiple devices?

Yes. Your data is tied to your account, so you can log activities on your phone and review your progress on your laptop — everything stays in sync.

#### Is my activity data private?

Your entries are only accessible when signed in to your account. Your personal data is never sold or shared.

#### Can I delete my data?

Yes. You can delete individual entries anytime, or permanently remove your entire account and all associated data from your profile — no questions asked.

#### Does Trackly work offline?

After installing, the app shell is cached so Trackly opens instantly, even on a weak connection. Logging and syncing need an internet connection so your data stays safely stored with your account.

---

## Help Center

# Help Center

Search common questions or contact support directly.

### How do I add a new activity entry?

Click the "Log Entry" button in the sidebar or bottom navigation, select a category, enter the numeric value for that habit (e.g. minutes, pages, cups), and save.

### How do I sign in without a password?

Enter your email on the sign-in page and we will send a six-digit code. The code expires after 10 minutes and can be used once. You can also continue with Google.

### Are email login codes secure?

Yes. Codes are single-use, expire after 10 minutes, and are stored as keyed hashes. Never share a code with anyone; Trackly will never ask for it outside the sign-in page.

### How do I create a new custom category?

Navigate to the "Categories" page from the sidebar, click "Add Category", then configure the name, unit type, color accent, and icon for your routine.

### What is a streak and how is it calculated?

A streak counts consecutive days where you recorded at least one activity. If a full calendar day passes without any entry, the current streak resets to 0.

### Is my personal activity data secure?

Yes. Your records are protected behind JWT authentication and stored in secure PostgreSQL database instances. Read our Privacy Policy for details.

### How do I delete my account and data?

Go to Profile settings, scroll to the Account Deletion section, and confirm deletion. You can also review our Data Deletion guide.

### Can I install Trackly on my smartphone?

Yes! Trackly is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Click "Download App" or select "Add to Home Screen" in your mobile browser.

## Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026 · Trackly Data Governance

Trackly is committed to providing a calm, private activity-tracking environment. This Privacy Policy outlines what information we store, how it is secured, and your rights over your personal history.

### 01. Information We Collect

We collect the minimum necessary information to provide personal habit tracking:

- Account identifiers: your name and email address. Email sign-in is verified with a one-time code; Google Sign-In provides your basic profile.
- Activity history: categories, entries, numeric values, completion logs, and personal notes.
- Technical data: aggregate analytics about how the website is used, described in section 04.

### 02. How We Use Your Information

We use your data solely to calculate statistics, streaks, and heatmap charts for your personal workspace, to authenticate you, and to keep the service reliable. We never sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties or advertising networks.

### 03. Passwordless Sign-In & Google OAuth

Trackly does not use passwords for authentication. You can sign in with a six-digit code sent to your email or with Google OAuth. Email codes expire after 10 minutes, can be used once, and are stored only as a keyed hash.

When you use Google Sign-In, we receive your basic profile (name and email) to authorize your account. We request no additional Google scopes. A Google account is linked to an existing Trackly account only when Google confirms that the email address is verified.

### 04. Analytics & Cookies

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand aggregate usage and improve the product. It may set first-party cookies such as `_ga` and collect the page path, device/browser information, approximate region, and interaction events such as calls-to-action.

Query strings are removed before analytics events are sent, so sign-in codes and email addresses do not appear in Google Analytics. We do not send habit entries, notes, or account identifiers to Google Analytics.

You can limit analytics with browser privacy settings or the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

### 05. Data Storage & Security

Data is stored in PostgreSQL database instances hosted via Supabase, served securely through Vercel over TLS. Passwords are not used for authentication; password hashes from before the passwordless migration are retained only for rollback and are never used to sign in. One-time login codes are stored only as HMAC hashes with a short expiry, and session tokens expire after seven days.

### 06. Data Retention & Control

Your records remain active for as long as your account exists. You maintain full rights to export your data or delete your account permanently at any time.

### 07. Your Rights & Data Deletion

You have full rights to request complete deletion of your account and logs. Visit the Data Deletion Instructions for step-by-step guidance.

### Contact & Inquiries

For any questions regarding privacy or data handling, contact ichwanpwt22@gmail.com.

### 01. Acceptance of Terms

### 02. Service Description

Trackly provides personal habit tracking, streak analytics, and visual activity heatmaps to assist users in building routines.

### 03. Account Responsibilities

You are responsible for keeping access to your email inbox secure and for all activities conducted under your account. Promptly notify us of any security compromise.

### 04. Ownership of User Content

All categories, numeric logs, notes, and custom entries remain strictly your property. Trackly processes this data solely to render your personal workspace.

### 05. Acceptable Conduct

You agree not to reverse engineer, disrupt service availability, or attempt unauthorized access to infrastructure hosting Trackly.

### 06. Third-Party Authentication

Email one-time codes are delivered through Resend. Google Sign-In is provided for authentication convenience. We fetch basic account attributes (name and email) strictly to match your user profile.

### 07. Service Modifications

We reserve the right to update, modify, or discontinue features of Trackly to improve performance, security, or maintainability.

## Data Deletion Instructions

Last updated: August 2026 · Account Removal Protocol

Trackly provides straightforward mechanisms to permanently delete your profile, habit categories, and activity logs from our servers.

### Option 01 — Self-Service Account Deletion

1. Log in to your Trackly account at https://tracklyid.vercel.app/login
2. Navigate to Profile / Settings in the main navigation.
3. Scroll down to the Danger Zone section.
4. Click Delete Account and confirm when prompted.

### Option 02 — Manual Deletion Request via Email

Send an email to ichwanpwt22@gmail.com with the subject line "Data Deletion Request". Specify the registered email address associated with your account. Requests are processed within 5 business days.

### Scope of Permanent Removal

Deletion is irreversible. Once processed, your account record, email address, custom category definitions, and daily activity logs will be permanently erased from PostgreSQL storage and backups.
